sourceFile: 26. TIU C11-20  Report check damage FS after Plasma 2025.12.27_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable FS damage results but invents a baseline/test comparison from shift and time rows.
issues: Changed factor is fabricated; no explicit baseline condition is shown.
Shift, time, side, and total rows are misused as changed conditions.
Outcome grouping loses row-level hierarchy for model side, shift, time, and totals.
Evidence covers only the first result block and omits later rows and decision context.
Change domain includes material without supporting evidence.
correctionPlan: Replace the changed factor with the explicit after-plasma inspection condition or mark baseline not applicable.
Treat date, shift, model side, time slot, and total as subgroup keys, not changed conditions.
Regroup outcomes as NG FS damage/input/OK/NG rate under the same report context.
Review rows beyond 28, including the decision section, for missing results or conclusions.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but cited rows are insufficient for the drafted comparison and may be incomplete.
